notes: «أن محمد بن عثمان، حدثهم» makes him a link (rule 5)
The text joins «عن أبي طوالة، وعمرو بن يحيى، عن أبيه» without a second «عن»; read as Abu Tawala, then Amr from his father, the order the names are written in
«قال عبد العزيز فأمر بجريدة» is Abd al-Aziz's remark on the saying, not a route; the two numbers of the cubits are wording variants
